subject: Draft MAP + legal redline ownership / SLA turnaround — next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medlytics.com>, procurement@medlytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + legal redline ownership / SLA turnaround — next steps

Hi Sarah / team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the Mutual Action Plan (MAP):

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: clinical-notes summarization for MedLytics CareOps team (non-PHI config for now).
- Technical POC targeted for Jan; procurement/legal cadence needed to hit a Feb pilot start.

Attachments: I attached the draft MAP (MAP_medlytics_v1.pdf) and a Redwood SLA template for reference (Redwood_SLA_template_2026.docx).

Request / asks:
1) Confirm target close date you want to work toward (we suggested 2027-02-10 on the call).
2) Legal milestone ownership: who on your side will own DPA review vs. MSA redlines? We propose Redwood handles initial MSA redline set (commercial/clauses) and we hand off to Internal Legal for final sign; request that MedLytics legal take DPA review.
3) Suggested turnaround times (TATs): Redwood proposes 48 business hours for an initial legal review/response, and asks MedLytics to target 72 business hours for counters. If these don't work for you, please propose alternatives.
4) Dependencies: security questionnaire completed (link in email), SOC2 audit copy, and procurement PO process.

Next steps (proposed owners):
- Jonas: overall MAP owner & commercial coordination (I’ll shepherd redlines).
- Ben: internal legal handoff & escalation contact for urgent redline issues.
- Marissa: formal legal lead for editing MSA draft and approving redline language.

Please reply with your ownership choices and any adjustments to TAT/target close. Once we have that, I’ll update the MAP and circulate a milestone schedule.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_medlytics_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_SLA_template_2026.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medlytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medlytics.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + legal redline ownership / SLA turnaround — next steps

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the MAP + SLA template. A few quick notes from MedLytics legal/procurement: 

1) Ownership: MedLytics legal will take point on the DPA review (privacy/data handling). For the MSA, we prefer Redwood to propose redlines first (helps speed things up), then we’ll have our counsel review and counter. That aligns with what you suggested.
2) TAT expectations: 72 business hours for our first counter is reasonable given end-of-year bandwidth; we can try to hit 48 hours for urgent sections if you flag them.
3) SLA specifics: we need the SLA to define error budget behavior for degraded model performance and clear uptime measurement windows. Can you indicate whether the attached SLA template supports per-route latency SLOs?
4) Dependencies: please also share the SOC2 report and a link to the security questionnaire answers; procurement will start the PO intake once legal milestone dates are set.

We’re aiming for a pilot start in early Feb as well; hopeful we can lock commercial/legal in Jan.

Regards,
Sarah Patel
Head of Partnerships | MedLytics
sarah.patel@medlytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0114

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medlytics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medlytics.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + legal redline ownership / SLA turnaround — next steps

Thanks Sarah — confirming Redwood’s proposed internal ownership and TATs. To be explicit about assignments from our side: 

- Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com): Redwood legal lead — will prepare initial MSA redline (commercial & liability language) and consolidate comments. Aim: initial redline back to MedLytics within 48 business hours of a formal MAP approval to proceed.
- Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com): Legal handback coordinator & escalation (if MedLytics response exceeds agreed TATs or requires C-suite exceptions).
- Jonas Weber: Deal owner / commercial coordinator — will track milestone dates and confirm pilot timeline with your team.

Proposed turnarounds (please confirm):
- Redwood initial MSA redline: 48 business hours after MAP signoff.
- MedLytics DPA review & counter: 72 business hours after receiving DPA draft.
- SLA technical clarifications: Redwood to provide annotated SLA with per-route latency SLO examples within 3 business days.

Dependencies we need from MedLytics:
- Completed security questionnaire (https://security.redwood.com/questionnaires/medlytics-2026)
- SOC2 Type II report (latest)
- Procurement PO path and any internal approval dates that would block Feb pilot start.

If that works, I’ll mark Marissa as owner in the MAP and propose milestone dates in the updated MAP document. If you prefer different owners/turnaround windows, flag them here.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Lead, Contract Strategy | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment references: Redwood will also push SOC2 to the secure portal once permission granted.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + legal redline ownership / SLA turnaround — next steps

Great — thanks all. Finalizing the MAP milestones below based on the assigned owners and agreed TATs. I’ll upload MAP_medlytics_v1.1 with dates after I hear confirmation from procurement on PO milestones.

MAP MILESTONES (draft)
- 2026-11-19: MAP version 1 circulated (owner: Jonas) — DONE
- 2026-11-22: Redwood initial MSA redline submitted to MedLytics (owner: Marissa) — target (48 business hours after MAP signoff)
- 2026-11-29: MedLytics to return DPA comments and MSA counters (owner: MedLytics legal) — target (72 business hours after receiving drafts)
- 2026-12-02: Redwood to provide annotated SLA with per-route latency SLO examples (owner: Jonas/Ben) — 3 business days
- 2027-01-05: Commercial terms locked & PO intake started (owner: MedLytics procurement)
- 2027-02-07: Pilot start target (owner: joint)

Open items / dependencies:
- MedLytics to confirm PO approval path and any blackout dates in Dec.
- MedLytics legal to confirm DPA owner (Sarah indicated they will own DPA review).
- Redwood to share SOC2 copy and complete security questionnaire link by 2026-11-24.

Action items (who/what/when):
- Marissa: prepare and send MSA redline by 2026-11-22.
- Jonas: update MAP to v1.1 with milestone dates and share Drive link by 2026-11-19 EOD.
- MedLytics (Sarah / procurement): confirm PO path and DPA owner by 2026-11-24.

If everyone agrees to these milestone dates I’ll mark them as committed in the MAP and we’ll use them to drive procurement/legal calendars. If MedLytics needs longer on any item, call out the specific milestone and proposed alternate date.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
